text: Mila's daughter starts reception next Tuesday. She's more nervous than the kid is tbh.

Hoang and his wife Rosa celebrating 10 yrs married end of the month, doing a small dinner at that Vietnamese place on the high street. Gift idea: he said Rosa's been eyeing a proper espresso machine but he thinks it's too boring for an anniversary. Their kids are staying at his brother's that night. Rosa only drinks decaf after lunch so maybe not lol
remind me to text Arturo good luck friday, his son's got his driving test and Arturo is a wreck about it
Bethany is vegan now, not just veggie. No honey either. Note for the barbecue.
Farid got engaged!! Proposed on the beach in Portugal over the weekend. Fiancée is called Imogen, met her at uni. Need to send them something nice.
Sofia's graduation is sometime in early July, Masters in architecture. Her mum and dad flying in from Lisbon for it.
bogdan doesnt drink anymore. 8 months sober he said. sparkling water w lime is his thing

Called Reza back. His sister Kasia's wedding got called off, she and the fiancé split up a couple of weeks ago. Reza's pretty cut up on her behalf. Check in with him next week sometime. Kasia's moved back in with their parents for now and has taken time off work. Maybe also send Kasia a little something, she loves those salted caramel truffles from the market.
Björn - coeliac, properly strict. Also hates coriander lol
Demi's twins finish nursery this Friday, little graduation ceremony with mortarboards and everything. She's sending pics.

Ravi asked if I'd be best man!! Wedding's next August in Leicester. Stag probably over the summer, he wants Prague. His fiancée Divya's vegetarian and her family are Gujarati so the reception's going to be a huge veggie feast, which honestly sounds amazing. Need to sort a suit and start thinking about the speech before Christmas.
Imogen's mum has her retirement do in a fortnight. Imogen doing the cake, chocolate orange because that's her mum's favourite.
Matilda's results come out Thursday. GCSEs. She's been really anxious, barely sleeping apparently. Must message her Thursday evening to see how they went.
Olivia and Tadhg — 25th wedding anniversary sometime next month, silver. Kids are throwing a surprise party, I'm doing the playlist.

Okay so voice note. Divya rang about Saturday. Her son Jin is starting at secondary in September and they've finally got the place they wanted, St Anne's, after the appeal. She was so relieved. Also she mentioned her husband's gone keto and it's driving her mad, so for the dinner on Saturday don't do the pasta thing, do something with meat and veg. And she doesn't drink red, white only.
note to self: book the venue tasting for next weekend, confirm numbers by end of the month
Hadiza loves really spicy food, the hotter the better. Scotch bonnet everything.
Miriam's grandson graduated from Edinburgh yesterday, first in the family to go to uni. She was beaming.
Mustafa allergic to tree nuts. Carries an epipen. Not peanuts weirdly, just tree nuts.
Haruto proposed to Sean last night!!! I'm so happy for them. Engagement drinks maybe the weekend after next
dont forget to get Dev a card for his and Isla's anniversary, its tuesday. 3 years
Siddharth's little one lost her first tooth this morning. Very proud. Tooth fairy left a pound apparently.
Stefan's PhD viva is end of next week. He's bricking it. I should text him the night before to wish him luck.
Rosa Costa from work - doesn't eat pork, halal only. Tea with two sugars.
Oisín's starting his apprenticeship Monday, electrician. His dad was an electrician too.
Isla's having her hen do in Dublin early March. Need to sort flights before they go up.
Amir mentioned his wife Mila's birthday is next Wednesday and he's got no idea what to get. She's into pottery, maybe a class voucher? Tell him.
Bethany and Farid's housewarming moved to next Saturday, not this one.
sean says his mum's 70th is the weekend after next. big family lunch
Arturo's daughter Sofia passed her ballet exam. Grade 5 with distinction. Congratulate her when I see them Sunday.
Grocery run tomorrow: oat milk, gluten free bread, the good olive oil.

Kasia's mum just been diagnosed with diabetes so the whole family's cutting sugar. Kasia's taking it hard, she does all the cooking for her. Her mum's got a follow up appointment sometime next week. I should look out some low sugar recipes and send them over, Kasia mentioned she's sick of the same three dinners.

Reza and his partner Bogdan off to Japan over the summer for their honeymoon. Two and a half weeks. Bogdan's been learning Japanese on Duolingo for months. Reza's worried about the food because he's allergic to sesame and it's in everything there. They fly out the first week of August, back just before Reza's brother's wedding at the end of the month.

ok quick one. Jin's oldest, Mustafa, is sitting his 11 plus in a few weeks, sometime early next month. Jin's more stressed than the boy is. Should drop off some of those brownies Mustafa likes the week before.
Imogen hates mushrooms. Like, genuinely gags. Don't make the risotto.
Followed up with Hoang about his son's first day at school last week. Went fine apparently, cried at drop off then didn't want to come home. Hoang said the teacher's lovely, Mrs Baker.
Tadhg's off dairy for a bit, his GP thinks he might be lactose intolerant. Test next Tuesday.
Need to RSVP to Demi and Ravi's wedding by Friday. Plus one or not, decide.
Matilda's grandad has his 60th anniversary with her nan this weekend. Diamond. Matilda's making a photo book for them, asked me to scan some old pics by Thursday.
Divya is the one who only drinks oat flat whites. Extra hot.

Long chat with Miriam on the phone tonight. Her daughter Hadiza is getting married in Lagos in the spring, probably late April, and Miriam is nervous about the trip because of her knee, she's having it looked at end of the month. She asked if I could help her find a hotel near the venue. Also her cat Biscuit is staying with the neighbour while she's away so that's sorted. Remind me to send her some hotel links this weekend and to ask how the knee appointment went.

Björn's son Haruto graduates from police academy next Thursday. Björn wanted me to come but I can't get the day off. Should send something. Björn says Haruto's into whisky lately, Japanese stuff, so maybe a nice bottle. His girlfriend Olivia's organising a meal for him on the Saturday after, which I might make.
Kasia's wedding is officially off. She seems ok actually, said it's for the best.
Siddharth and Divya - 15 years since they met, celebrating with a weekend in the Lakes sometime in November
Pick up suit from the tailor on Friday, dinner with the in laws Saturday.
Olivia's dog Pepper had her puppies yesterday, six of them! She asked if I want one.
Stefan Moreau, Isla's dad. Big wine guy, Burgundy especially. Good for xmas presents.
Farid said Imogen's pregnant, due early March. Keep it quiet for now. Her morning sickness is awful.
Sean's sister Rosa just got into med school in Galway, starts in September. Message her congrats tomorrow.
Amir doesn't eat after 6pm, some intermittent fasting thing. So lunch not dinner when we meet.
Oisín - goes by Osh. Dad's retiring next spring after 40 years on the buses.

Dictated walking home. Haruto told me Sean's mum Mrs Thomas isn't well, she's in hospital since Sunday with a chest infection, and the engagement party they had planned for Saturday is cancelled because of it. They're going to rearrange for sometime in the new year. Haruto sounds exhausted, he's been doing the hospital runs every evening. Need to ring him tomorrow and maybe drop a lasagne round, he said Sean's been living on vending machine crisps.
Bethany's boy Dev starts uni at Leeds in a fortnight. She's not coping well with the empty nest thing.
mila likes white wine, dry, sauv blanc. not prosecco
Remind me to ask Ravi how his little sister's graduation went on Saturday.
Reza's daughter got her first school report, all good apart from talking too much in class haha

Talked to Demi about her wedding menu. Her fiancé Arturo has a shellfish allergy so no prawns, and half the guests are vegetarian. Tasting is next Tuesday, then final numbers due to the caterer by the end of the month. She's stressed about the seating plan more than anything, his parents are divorced and don't speak. I said I'd help with the table plan this weekend. Should also bring her those lemon biscuits she likes.
Hadiza and Mustafa anniversary dinner tomorrow night. They always go back to the Lebanese place where they had their first date.
Bogdan's kid starts secondary Monday. Bogdan's taking the morning off to walk him in.
Nothing much from the call with Farid, just catching up. He's well.
